description: This file defines types and functions for managing system presence information, including gathering system details, updating presence data, and maintaining a presence list with expiration logic.

methods.name: normalizePresenceKey
methods.description: Normalizes a presence key by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvePrimaryIPv4
methods.description: Resolves the primary IPv4 address or hostname.

methods.name: initSelfPresence
methods.description: Initializes the system's own presence information and stores it.

methods.name: ensureSelfPresence
methods.description: Ensures that self presence is initialized, re-initializing if necessary.

methods.name: touchSelfPresence
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the self presence entry.

methods.name: parsePresence
methods.description: Parses a presence text string into a SystemPresence object.

methods.name: mergeStringList
methods.description: Merges multiple string arrays into a unique list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: updateSystemPresence
methods.description: Updates or creates a system presence entry based on provided payload.

methods.name: upsertPresence
methods.description: Inserts or updates a presence entry with given key and partial data.

methods.name: listSystemPresence
methods.description: Returns a list of current presence entries, pruning expired ones and maintaining max size.
